facts.text: The user asked how many possible paths from node A to node D in a given graph.
The user provided a graph with nodes A, B, C, and D and node aliases la, sa; sb, bb; ca; td, md.
The user provided edges from A to B with health ok and lines aa1 and aa2.
The user provided an edge from A to C with health unhealthy and lines aa3 and aa4.
The user provided an edge from B to C with health unhealthy and line aa5.
The user provided an edge from C to D with health ok and line aa6.
The user provided an edge from B to D with health ok and lines aa7 and ab8.
The user asked how many paths from alias "sb" to alias "td".
The user asked to list all "lines" from alias "sa" to alias "md".
The user asked to return all possible joined lines from "sa" to "md" in an array as JSON when the edges' health are "ok".

keyphrases: number of paths from A to D
graph nodes A B C D
node aliases la sa sb bb ca td md
lines aa1 aa2 aa3 aa4 aa5 aa6 aa7 ab8
joined lines from sa to md
possible joined lines with health ok
